title: Semester comparison
statementMd:
Average score per semester, rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `semester`, `avg_score`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT semester, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS avg_score FROM enrollments GROUP BY semester;
```
